Problem Summary:
ightning should not run duplicate detection on non-unique index.

### What changed and how does it work?
skip non-unique index for duplicate detection.

issue_context.title: lightning should not run duplicate detection on non-unique index
issue_context.body:
by the KV format of non-unique index, there's no need to check non-unique index KV overwritten because values are always empty

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/afd8de1f62188516b8bdc50c292262a20b33bd0c/pkg/lightning/backend/local/duplicate.go#L721-L725

we can skip for non-unique index here

review_comments: please also check if the clustered / non-clustered PK will appear in `m.tbl.Meta().Indices` and their `.Unique` values
